rv.q: Aardman’s 50th-anniversary celebration proves that these clay icons are timeless and they have never looked bigger or better.
Despite its familiar archive material, the show's all-encompassing presentation makes even the most recognisable moments from Aardman's body of work feel fresh, immersive and alive.
Ensuring there is something for everyone to be found at this cracking experience.

cn.t: Critics praise this immersive celebration of Aardman's 50-year legacy, with the 360-degree Lightroom venue bringing beloved British animations to spectacular life on a grand scale.
